description: Switch between the threads you are working on from a row of tabs across the top of the bb window. Every thread you open gets a tab with bb's status glyph, so a thread that is working, needs input, or has unread output shows without the sidebar. Close tabs with × or a middle-click, drag them to reorder, and cycle through them with Ctrl+Tab. Right-click a tab for bb's thread menu plus Close other tabs and Close tabs to the right. Tabs are stored per window on your machine, with no account or external service; requires bb 0.49 or later.
